home.title: Tinytide — the gentle baby tracker
home.tagline: The gentle baby tracker. Sleep, feeds, diapers and growth, synced privately through your own iCloud and shared with the people who help.
home.badge: Coming soon to the App Store
home.features.title: Everything in one tap
home.features.lead: Built for one-handed use at 3 a.m.
home.f1.title: Sleep & sweet spot
home.f1.body: Time naps and nights, and see when the next nap is likely to go well, based on age and your baby's own rhythm.
home.f2.title: Nursing & bottles
home.f2.body: Left and right timers that remember which side is next, plus bottles, solids and pumping.
home.f3.title: Diapers & health
home.f3.body: Diapers, medication reminders, temperature and symptoms, all in one timeline.
home.f4.title: Growth & trends
home.f4.body: WHO growth percentiles, a 24-hour daily rhythm chart, and weekly trends for sleep and feeds.
home.f5.title: Shared with family
home.f5.body: Invite a partner, grandparent or nanny. Everyone logs and sees the same day, in real time.
home.f6.title: Lock Screen & widgets
home.f6.body: Running timers live on the Lock Screen and Dynamic Island. Log a diaper straight from a widget.
home.privacy.title: Your data stays yours
home.privacy.body: Tinytide has no servers, no accounts, no ads and no tracking. Everything is stored on your iPhone and in your own private iCloud. Read the privacy policy.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy — Tinytide
privacy.intro: Tinytide is designed so that your family's data stays with you.
privacy.collect.p: Nothing. Tinytide has no servers, no accounts, no analytics, no advertising and no tracking. The developer cannot see anything you log.
privacy.where.li1: On your device, and in your own private iCloud database (Apple CloudKit) if you are signed in to iCloud. This is how Tinytide backs up your data and syncs it between your devices. Apple provides this storage under Apple's Privacy Policy.
privacy.where.li2: Widgets and Live Activities read a small summary stored on your device.
privacy.sharing.p: If you choose to share a baby with someone, Apple's iCloud sharing makes that baby's entries available to the people you invite. You can see who has access, and stop sharing at any time, in More → Family & Caregivers.
privacy.exports.p: Backup and CSV files are created only when you ask, and go only where you send them.
privacy.notifications.p: Reminders are scheduled locally on your device.
privacy.purchases.p: The optional Tinytide Supporter subscription and tips are processed entirely by Apple through In-App Purchase. Tinytide never receives your payment details.
privacy.children.p: Parents and caregivers use Tinytide to record information about their children. Tinytide does not collect any of that information.
privacy.delete.p: Delete a baby in More → Babies, or delete the app. To remove the iCloud copy, open Settings → [your name] → iCloud → Manage Account Storage → Tinytide on your iPhone.
privacy.changes.p: If this policy changes, the new version will be posted on this page with a new date.
privacy.contact.p: Questions about this policy? Email support@tinytide.app, or see the Support page.
support.title: Support — Tinytide
support.lead: Answers to common questions about Tinytide.
support.share.q: How do I share with my partner or a caregiver?
support.share.li1: Open More → Family & Caregivers and tap Share [baby's name].
support.share.li2: Send the invitation by Messages, Mail or any other app.
support.share.li3: They open the link on an iPhone with Tinytide installed and accept. The baby appears in their app and stays in sync.
support.share.p: Both of you need to be signed in to iCloud. From the same screen you can see who has access, change permissions, or stop sharing.
support.move.q: I got a new iPhone. How do I move my data?
support.move.p1: Same Apple ID: sign in to iCloud on the new phone and install Tinytide. Your data downloads automatically.
support.move.p2: Different Apple ID: on the old phone, go to More → Backup & Transfer → Export Backup File, AirDrop it to the new phone, then choose Import Backup File there. Importing merges entries and never creates duplicates.
support.sync.q: My entries are not syncing between devices.
support.sync.li1: Check that you are signed in to iCloud on every device, with iCloud enabled for Tinytide (Settings → [your name] → iCloud → Apps Using iCloud).
support.sync.li2: If your iCloud storage is full, sync pauses until there is space. Your data is still safe on the device.
support.sync.li3: Open Tinytide and keep it open for a minute. More → iCloud Sync shows the last sync time.
support.supporter.q: What do I get with Tinytide Supporter?
support.supporter.p: Every tracking feature in Tinytide is free. Supporters get alternate app icons, theme colors and a supporter badge as a thank-you, and the subscription can be shared with your family through Family Sharing.
support.cancel.q: How do I cancel or change my subscription?
support.cancel.p: Open Settings → [your name] → Subscriptions → Tinytide on your iPhone, or tap Manage on the Tinytide Supporter screen in the app. Apple handles all billing.
support.restore.q: I reinstalled the app. How do I restore my subscription?
support.restore.p: Go to More → Support Tinytide → Tinytide Supporter and tap Restore Purchases.
support.medical.p: No. Sleep predictions, growth percentiles and health alerts are general guidance only. Always talk to your pediatrician about your baby's health.
support.contact.p: Email us at support@tinytide.app and we'll get back to you, usually within a few days. Please tell us your iPhone model and iOS version, and don't include your baby's personal details.
